about: A Castform that loses Forecast or has it suppressed goes back to its Normal Form (Pokemon Central, Previsioni; the reference's BattleFormChangeCheck.c:85). A level-10 Pikachu is given Sunny Day and Gastro Acid in the running battle (teach:) against a forced wild Castform that knows only Splash: Sunny Day brings its Sunny Form, and Gastro Acid, with the sun still out, its Normal Form back. Before, Forecast was asked before anything else, so the suppressed Castform kept its Sunny Form. The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.
